{
  "dataset_name": "jungle_chess_2pcs_raw_endgame_complete",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "strength_diff_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized difference in piece strength between white and black, scaled to [-1, 1] for linear margin contribution.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "material_balance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Directly informs material advantage which is a strong linear signal for board outcomes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(white_piece0_strength - black_piece0_strength) / 7.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "strength_ratio_smoothed",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Smoothed ratio of white strength over total strength using log1p to dampen extremes.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "material_balance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a bounded ratio useful for linear separation of material dominance.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "log1p(white_piece0_strength) / (log1p(white_piece0_strength) + log1p(black_piece0_strength) + 0.001)"
    },
    {
      "name": "chebyshev_distance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Chebyshev (king-move) distance between the two pieces on the board.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "spatial_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Distance between pieces is a continuous severity measure for engagement likelihood.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "maximum(abs(white_piece0_file - black_piece0_file), abs(white_piece0_rank - black_piece0_rank))"
    },
    {
      "name": "manhattan_distance_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized Manhattan distance between the two pieces, scaled to [0,1].",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "spatial_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth continuous proximity signal compatible with linear projections.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(abs(white_piece0_file - black_piece0_file) + abs(white_piece0_rank - black_piece0_rank)) / 14.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "euclidean_distance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance between the two pieces on the board.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 11.0],
      "feature_family": "spatial_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth distance metric useful in margin-based separators.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "sqrt((white_piece0_file - black_piece0_file) ** 2 + (white_piece0_rank - black_piece0_rank) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "rank_advance_diff",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference in vertical board advancement between white and black pieces normalized to [-1,1].",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "positional",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Vertical positioning often correlates linearly with strategic advantage.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(white_piece0_rank - black_piece0_rank) / 8.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "file_alignment_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "How aligned the pieces are on the file axis, 1.0 when same file, decreasing linearly to 0.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "positional",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures column alignment relevant to piece confrontation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "1.0 - abs(white_piece0_file - black_piece0_file) / 6.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "center_proximity_white",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Proximity of white piece to board center, smooth continuous score.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "positional",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Central control is a continuous severity measure for board advantage.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "1.0 - (abs(white_piece0_file - 3.0) + abs(white_piece0_rank - 4.0)) / 7.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "center_proximity_black",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Proximity of black piece to board center, smooth continuous score.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "positional",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Mirror of white proximity used for differential linear features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "1.0 - (abs(black_piece0_file - 3.0) + abs(black_piece0_rank - 4.0)) / 7.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "weighted_material_position",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite linear projection combining strength advantage with rank advancement.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Weighted composite directly aids linear SVM margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(white_piece0_strength - black_piece0_strength) / 7.0 + (white_piece0_rank - black_piece0_rank) / 8.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "strength_per_distance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of strength differential to distance, capturing threat intensity per unit separation.",
      "value_range": [-7.0, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines material and distance into a single continuous severity score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "clip((white_piece0_strength - black_piece0_strength) / (sqrt((white_piece0_file - black_piece0_file) ** 2 + (white_piece0_rank - black_piece0_rank) ** 2) + 1.0), -7.0, 7.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "tactical_engagement_severity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of how tactically engaged the position is, considering close proximity and comparable strength suggesting imminent capture, scaled smoothly from 0 (passive) to 1 (highly engaged).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a non-formulaic severity score reflecting position tension, complementing linear distance and material features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
